lens: Recheck R-002 against sandbox_prefix and other claims in the selected notes and docs.

findings.summary: The socket-reachability exceptions omit exact home-file masks.
evidence: The notes and docs say other host Unix sockets stay reachable unless under /run/user/<uid>, a masked home directory, or excluded /tmp trees.

sandbox_prefix also masks existing home paths individually from _SECRET_FILES, including .netrc, .npmrc, and .claude.json. A socket at one of those exact paths is not under a masked home directory, but the sandbox masks that path.
findings.action: Qualify both claims to include masked home files as well as masked home directories.

counterweight_triage.concern: Prior R-002: sockets under other masked home paths were missing from the exceptions.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The new wording covers masked home directories, but omits exact home-file masks.

next_move: Add masked home files to the socket-reachability exceptions, then recheck the claims.
non_claims: Assessment is limited to the supplied semantic input; tests and sandbox behavior were not executed.
The notes accurately disclose that tests do not pin the other listed daemon socket paths or the /run/user/<uid> mask.
